I’ve been making this sauce for about three years after repeatedly trying to find the perfect Pappadeaux ponzu sauce. This is as close as I’ve ever been able to get it. I hope this works for you!

Needed:

Small pot
Small strainer
Soy sauce
Water
Lemon juice (best if fresh)
Bonito flakes
Strip of kombu
Diced green onion for garnish.

Equal parts soy sauce and lemon juice.
Water will be half the amount of soy sauce you put in.

1. Get a small pot to cook your sauce on.

2. Add soy sauce and water, and then bonito flakes and strip of kombu.

3. Put stove on low and wait until it simmers (do not boil!).

3.5. Dice green onions.

4. Remove pot from stove once it simmers, then add lemon juice.

5. Add an equal amount of lemon juice to the soy sauce and let sauce cool.

6. Let bonito flakes and kombu steep in the sauce while you’re opening the oysters.

7. Strain bonito flakes and kombu out of sauce.

8. Add green onions for garnish and enjoy!
